cases.query: Trong file MSHTA gốc, command line đầy đủ của conhost.exe được PowerShell khởi chạy là gì, và hai raw records nào ghi nhận cùng lần tạo đó?
cases.reference_answer: Security 4688 line 36 và Sysmon 1 line 422 cùng ghi conhost.exe với command line \??\C:\windows\system32\conhost.exe 0xffffffff -ForceV1. PID con 0x27b4 tương ứng 10164; PID cha PowerShell 0x2564 tương ứng 9572. Sysmon ParentProcessGuid ở line 422 khớp ProcessGuid PowerShell ở line 398. Đây là một nhóm tạo conhost ngoài hai nhóm core, không thêm process MSHTA hoặc PowerShell và không gán ý định tấn công.
cases.label_rationale: Các trường command line, image, PID và parent GUID hỗ trợ câu trả lời trực tiếp; correlation Security/Sysmon vẫn là inferred.

frozen_baseline_eligibility.scoring_rule: Do not count abstain on this full-raw positive as a false abstain with the frozen core context.

cases.query: Which termination observations are recorded for the MSHTA process, and what status value does the Security record contain?
cases.reference_answer: Security Event ID 4689 at line 42 records ProcessName C:\Windows\System32\mshta.exe, ProcessId 0x2ae4 and Status 0x0 at TimeCreated 2020-10-22T02:58:00.599Z. Sysmon Event ID 5 at line 452 records Image mshta.exe, PID 10980 and ProcessGuid {39e4a257-2d77-5f91-6b13-000000000700}, which matches the creation GUID at line 275. These are two telemetry views of MSHTA termination. Status 0x0 is a raw process-exit field, not proof of PowerShell success, cmdlet completion or service state. Preserve Sysmon UtcTime separately.
cases.label_rationale: Termination events are observed in the complete raw file; the raw status is stated without converting it into a security conclusion.

novelty_assessment.difference: Old queries ask process creation or launch command, not termination or Security Status.
novelty_assessment.overlap_detail: Creation line 275 is reused for identity correlation; termination lines 42/452 were outside the reviewed core.

frozen_baseline_eligibility.scoring_rule: Do not count abstain on this full-raw positive as a false abstain with the frozen core context.

cases.query: Ba record log-clearing trong file MSHTA gốc nêu log nào bị clear, TimeCreated nào, và thứ tự timestamp có trùng thứ tự dòng trong file không?
cases.reference_answer: Line 1 là Eventlog 1102 trên Security, TimeCreated 2020-10-22T02:57:56.178Z, Message bắt đầu "The audit log was cleared." Line 1126 là Eventlog 104 trên System, Message "The System log file was cleared.", TimeCreated 2020-10-22T02:57:56.240Z. Line 1127 cũng là Eventlog 104 trên System nhưng Message "The Application log file was cleared.", TimeCreated 2020-10-22T02:57:56.256Z. Theo ba TimeCreated này thứ tự tăng là 1 → 1126 → 1127, nhưng hai record cuối nằm sau nhiều record có timestamp muộn hơn. Không dùng vị trí dòng làm thứ tự toàn cục, không suy ra process gây clear hoặc kỹ thuật tấn công.
cases.label_rationale: Provider/channel/event ID and messages establish what was logged. Message identifies Application clear although its containing channel is System; no invented channel normalization.

original_fields.Message: The System log file was cleared.
The Application log file was cleared.

novelty_assessment.difference: Old scope mentions log clearing without target logs/timestamps; old launch-order task concerns directed process relationships, not timestamp ordering of these records.
novelty_assessment.overlap_detail: Existence of log-clearing telemetry was already known; exact channel/message distinction is a new review target.

frozen_baseline_eligibility.scoring_rule: Do not count abstain on this full-raw positive as a false abstain with the frozen core context.

cases.query: What was the exit status of the PowerShell process launched through MSHTA, and exactly how long did that PowerShell process live?
cases.reference_answer: The collected file does not provide a PowerShell termination observation or exit status. Lines 30/398 show its launch. The one Security 4689 and one Sysmon 5 instead describe MSHTA termination (lines 42/452). They cannot supply the PowerShell exit code or lifetime. Abstain from the requested values; do not infer that PowerShell never exited outside this collection.
cases.label_rationale: Complete-file inspection found zero PowerShell Event ID 5/4689 observations; MSHTA exit values cannot be transferred to its child.

novelty_assessment.difference: Old questions ask launch command/attack certainty, not exit-code or lifecycle duration. Distinct from cmdlet output even though both concern missing outcome telemetry.
novelty_assessment.overlap_detail: PowerShell launch anchors 30/398 overlap core; outcome requirement is new.

Abstain from naming a responsible process or command line; no new attack technique is assigned.
cases.label_rationale: The raw log-clearing event dictionaries have no CommandLine, Image/NewProcessName or initiating-process identifier fields. Timestamp proximity alone does not establish the missing causal edge.
